_comment: Copy to a private path outside the repository and fill in by hand after the cluster exists. clusterUid is the UID of the kube-system namespace of THAT cluster, read once with its own credentials. Not valid as it stands.
name: kind-resilience-validation
apiServer: REPLACE with the API server address in the validation kubeconfig, e.g. https://127.0.0.1:PORT
clusterUid: REPLACE with the kube-system namespace UID of the validation cluster
designatedBy: REPLACE with the name of the person designating the cluster
